## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass (`pytest`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`)
- [ ] `shellcheck deploy.sh scripts/*.sh` is clean (if scripts changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `.env.example`) where behaviour changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, databases or backups included
- [ ] Tested on a clean VM or fresh install (required for installer, compose or nginx changes)
